name: IDEX
description: IDEX owns a collection of small engineered businesses that make the pumps, flow meters, valves, optics, seals, firefighting equipment and dispensing gear inside other machines and processes. A typical product is a custom component or small system that a customer designs in and then reorders (a pump in an analyzer, a fire pump on a fire truck, a meter at a fuel terminal), sold through distributors, OEM contracts and direct. Growth comes from acquisitions such as Mott (sintered porous metal parts) plus price. No customer exceeds 3 percent of sales.

employees.note: Approximately 8,700 employees; about 4 percent covered by US collective bargaining agreements.

businessLines.name: Health & Science Technologies (HST)
businessLines.how: Sells precision fluidics, optics, pneumatic, sealing and material-processing components designed into medical, analytical, semiconductor and industrial equipment: OEM design-in then repeat orders, plus acquired businesses like Mott.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), external sales from the revenue note

operatingProfit.period: FY2025, segment Adjusted EBITDA (not operating income)

businessLines.name: Fluid & Metering Technologies (FMT)
businessLines.how: Sells pumps, water-infrastructure inspection and repair products, flow meters and terminal automation for fuel, agricultural pumps and valves, and specialty valves to industrial, municipal, energy and farm customers: product sales through distributors and direct, with repeat replacement demand.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), external sales from the revenue note

operatingProfit.period: FY2025, segment Adjusted EBITDA (not operating income)

businessLines.name: Fire & Safety/Diversified Products (FSDP)
businessLines.how: Sells fire pumps, valves, nozzles and controls to fire-truck builders, rescue tools, stainless banding (BAND-IT) and paint-dispensing equipment to retailers: mostly OEM and distributor equipment sales.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), external sales from the revenue note

operatingProfit.period: FY2025, segment Adjusted EBITDA (not operating income)

brands.name: Mott Corporation
brands.note: Acquired during 2024; sintered porous metal components for medical, energy, semiconductor and space markets; main driver of HST acquisition growth. Purchase price not read from the 10-K text.
